`RESULTS.json` is written. Summary of the quarter (May–July 2026):

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Revenue | €1,233,225 |
| Costs | €467,640 |
| Net | €765,585 (margin 62.1%) |
| Net customer adds | 153 (69 + 52 + 32) |
| Ticket close rate | 95.5% (956 of 1,001) |
| June growth | +4.6% |
| July growth | −9.6% |

One anomaly found and flagged in `notes`: June's cost line items sum to €158,540 but the report states €158,240 — a €300 discrepancy. I used the stated totals for consistency (May and July totals match their line items exactly). The notes also flag the worsening trend: July revenue decline, rising churn (17 → 22 → 31), and falling signups (86 → 74 → 63).
